changes.title: fix: make v1Activity.result nullable to handle CONSENSUS_NEEDED
changes.note: v1Activity.result is now typed v1Result? instead of v1Result. The Turnkey API omits the result field when an activity is pending consensus approval (ACTIVITY_STATUS_CONSENSUS_NEEDED), which previously caused a runtime null-cast crash.
